name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
about: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (2009-031A, GSFC), launched 2009 Jun 18. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
